name: ingresso-recital
description: The first run in the integrated Test: Beatriz asks for one ticket to the December recital; the code prices the cart (R$ 45,00); she accepts and asks to pay; the attendant confirms the order (human) or the sales policy does (mandate), and ONE bolepix due today is issued for it. On the simulator the stub rail issues and the stub payer pays; hosted on codespar-test the charge is a platform receive proposal the person sends, the platform issues at the provider's sandbox and its Test payer pays. Same trail in both modes.

turns.input: oi, sou a Beatriz. quero um ingresso para o recital de dezembro
